project.name: Abrevia App
project.description: Zero-friction bilingual asynchronous relay platform connecting English-speaking operators with Spanish-speaking workforce and clients via multi-channel dispatch (SMS, WhatsApp, Email), two-way SMS automation (Textbee), and bidirectional web bridge.
project.primary_jurisdiction: United States of America (USA exclusively, +1 telephone routing)
project.design_language: High-contrast minimalist dark mode (white text on dark background), token-efficient, zero decorative fluff, 100% mobile-optimized.

operator_profile.technical_level: Advanced computer user, non-technical in cloud/IT/software engineering.
ai_collaboration_guidelines: Always conduct a feasibility and viability assessment of every prompt prior to coding.
Clearly explain technical trade-offs, limitations, and industry standards in accessible, non-jargon terms.
Test mobile responsiveness (360px-430px smartphone viewports) for all releases.
Maintain strict high-contrast minimalist aesthetic to conserve tokens and optimize readability.
Strictly respect Vercel Hobby serverless function ceiling (maximum 12 functions).
Mirror every commit to the external storage drive at D:\02 PROJECTS\abrevia\.

serverless_functions_budget.headroom: 1 slot remaining safely below Vercel Hobby ceiling
serverless_functions_budget.routing_strategy: Vercel rewrites map /api/webhooks/textbee and /api/webhook/textbee to /api/inbound-sms, keeping serverless function count at 11.

frontend.technology: Vanilla ECMAScript 2022 (ES6+), Tailwind CSS via CDN, Progressive Web App (PWA) manifest.
frontend.state_management: localStorage with ephemeral RAM ticket caching, 3000ms polling

backend.database: Supabase PostgreSQL (tickets, messages, contacts) with graceful in-memory fallback

ai_engine.provider: Google Gemini API (@google/genai SDK & fetch REST)
capabilities: Self-correcting grammar, typos, phonetic errors, and SMS shorthand
Cultural context preservation and professional tone polish

relay_and_communication_tier.active_recipient_model: Multi-Channel Dispatch with Option C Web Bridge & Two-Way Textbee SMS Relay

textbee_sms_cellular.mechanism: Android Gateway REST dispatch via paired Samsung device (https://api.textbee.dev/api/v1/gateway/devices/.../send-sms)
textbee_sms_cellular.cost: $0.00 carrier SMS included in cellular plan

whatsapp.cost: $0.00 (Zero third-party API keys, zero business verification delay)

textbee_two_way_sms.workflow: Recipient replies via SMS on their phone -> Samsung Android device receives message -> Textbee triggers webhook POST to /api/webhooks/textbee -> endpoint normalizes phone, resolves active ticket in Supabase, translates Spanish to English via Gemini, persists message to Supabase messages table (sender: 'customer'), and renders in real-time on operator dashboard.

option_c_web_bridge.workflow: Recipient receives translated text via WhatsApp/SMS/Email, clicks link, opens lightweight Spanish mobile page, types reply in Spanish, posts to /api/tickets, Gemini translates to English in real time, appears immediately in operator workspace.

safety_net_inbound_paste.workflow: If recipient replies directly to operator personal WhatsApp or SMS number, operator clicks 'Paste Inbound' on dashboard to record and auto-translate response into thread.

legal_neutrality_signature_stamp.reply_link_field: Para responder en español a su operador, toque aquí: [m.html?t=...]
legal_neutrality_signature_stamp.liability_disclaimer: Aviso: Este mensaje fue transmitido mediante la plataforma de comunicación Abrevia App. Abrevia App es una herramienta tecnológica de retransmisión y no es responsable del contenido, transacciones ni acuerdos entre las partes.

/api/webhooks/textbee.description: Inbound webhook receiver for Textbee MESSAGE_RECEIVED events. Captures incoming SMS replies, auto-resolves tickets, translates Spanish to English via Gemini, and persists to Supabase.

/api/inbound-sms.description: Multi-provider inbound SMS webhook receiver (httpSMS and Textbee compatible).

/api/tickets.description: Unified conversation management, message audit history, ping healthcheck, and real-time Spanish to English translation for recipient replies.

/api/translate.description: Bidirectional translation endpoint utilizing Gemini AI with fallbacks.

/api/accept-terms.description: Records clickwrap acceptance audit trail (device ID, timestamp, user agent, IP hash) for legal enforceability.

/api/contacts.description: Contact directory management with phone normalization, carrier opt-out tracking, and auto-saving.

/api/send-sms.description: Outbound SMS dispatch via Textbee Android gateway or httpSMS.

/api/stripe-webhook.description: Stripe billing and subscription status synchronization.

/api/checkout.description: Stripe checkout session creation and customer billing portal.

/api/upload.description: Document and image upload handler to Supabase storage.

/api/whatsapp-webhook.description: Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API webhook verification and message receiver.

legal_and_compliance.data_retention: Zero permanent message retention on server databases; ephemeral routing.
legal_and_compliance.hipaa_status: Beta testing tier strictly prohibits transmission of Protected Health Information (PHI). Pre-signed BAA and enterprise roadmap ready for clinical production.
legal_and_compliance.clickwrap_terms: Electronic acceptance modal with touch-scroll lock elimination, individual binding arbitration, class action waiver, and $100 aggregate liability cap.
legal_and_compliance.tcpa_compliance: Automated carrier keyword opt-out (STOP, ALTO, CANCEL, BAJA, UNSUBSCRIBE, QUIT, END) and opt-in (START, UNSTOP, REANUDAR, INICIAR) tracking.

evaluation_guide_for_external_ai.assessment_prompt: You are reviewing the architecture and codebase of Abrevia App. Review the configuration, data flow, multi-channel dispatch model (SMS, WhatsApp, Email), Option C recipient bridge, Textbee two-way SMS automation, and legal neutrality framework. Assess its scalability, mobile ergonomics, carrier compliance, and identify the next 3 high-impact technical milestones.
